name: Tree View
hint: Turn on Sample content, then drag “Hero / CTA” into Order summary: slide left or right to pick the depth, hover a closed frame to spring it open. Then try Alt+Arrows.
description: A hierarchical WAI-ARIA tree for any nested data: you pass `nodes` (id, label, icon, children, a `hasChildren` flag for lazy branches) and own expansion, selection and checks, each controlled or uncontrolled. Expanding unfolds children on a height spring with a short stagger while their indentation guides draw down; the guide of the branch holding the focused row is highlighted. Lazy branches call `onLoadChildren(node)` and show skeleton rows while it runs. Pass `onMove` and rows drag to reorder and re-parent with pointer events (long-press on touch): a drop line shows before or after, its depth set by the pointer's horizontal position, closed folders spring open after 600ms of hover, drops into a node's own descendants are refused with a shake, and the moved node glides to its new place (FLIP); Alt+Arrows move by keyboard. Single or multiple selection (Shift and Cmd), a tri-state checkbox mode with animated mixed parents, a filter that keeps matches with their ancestors and restores the previous expansion when cleared, F2 / double-click rename with `onRename`. Full keyboard model: arrows, Home, End, type-ahead, * to expand siblings, one tab stop. The sample content is a design tool's layers panel and a SvelteKit repo's file tree.
intents: layers panel with drag to reorder
hierarchical tree view with keyboard navigation
nested list drag and drop re-parent
usage: Use for any hierarchy people browse: a file explorer, a docs or CMS outline, a category or permissions tree, a layers panel. Pass `nodes` (nested, with stable ids), own `expanded` + `onExpandedChange` and `selected` + `onSelect` (or start from `defaultExpanded` / `defaultSelected`), pick `selectionMode`, and use `onActivate` for opening a leaf. Give lazy branches `hasChildren: true` and load them in `onLoadChildren` (return a promise, or set `loading` on the node). Turn on `checkboxes` when the task is picking a subset, so parents show a mixed state; pass `onMove` / `onRename` only if people may rearrange. Keep the filter once a tree passes a few dozen nodes. For a flat list that only reorders, use a sortable list instead; for two levels of navigation, use a sidebar with sections.

dataProps.description: Nested nodes: [{ id, label, icon?, children?, hasChildren?, disabled?, loading?, textValue? }]. label is a string or node (give textValue for type-ahead and the filter when it is a node); icon is a kit icon name or a node; hasChildren: true with no children marks a lazy branch; loading: true shows its skeleton rows (caller-owned busy).
Controlled ids of open branches. Pass with onExpandedChange.
Uncontrolled ids of branches open at first.
(ids, { node, expanded }) => void when a branch opens or closes (arrow keys, the chevron, Enter, *, a drop).
Controlled selection: an id (or null) in single mode, an array of ids in multiple mode. Pass with onSelect.
Uncontrolled starting selection.
(selection, node) => void: selection is an id or null (single) or an array of ids (multiple); node is the row that changed it.
Multiple adds Shift (range), Cmd/Ctrl (toggle) and Cmd+A. None drops aria-selected.
Controlled ids of checked leaves (with checkboxes). Parents derive on / mixed / off. Pass with onCheckedChange.
Uncontrolled checked leaf ids.
(leafIds, { node, checked }) => void when a box is toggled (Space or a click).

(node) => void | Promise, called when a lazy branch (hasChildren, no children) opens. Return a promise to have the row show skeletons until it settles, or set loading on the node yourself; then pass the node with its children.
(node, event) => void on Enter or a click on a leaf (Enter on a branch folds it).

({ ids, parentId, index, nodes }) => void after a drag or Alt+Arrow move: put ids under parentId (null for the top level) starting at index in its children after the move. Dragging and Alt+Arrows are only on when this is passed; apply it to nodes yourself.
(node, label) => void from F2 or a double-click. Renaming is only on when this is passed.
(node, { selected, expanded, depth, filter, disabled }) => node drawn in place of the label. The row keeps its treeitem role, keyboard and name (from label / textValue).
Controlled filter text. Pass with onFilterChange.
Uncontrolled starting filter text.
(text) => void as the filter field changes.
Placeholder and accessible name of the filter field.
Heading above the tree; also the tree's accessible name (else aria-label, else "Tree").
A line under the title.
You are loading the whole tree: skeleton rows in its shape, aria-busy.
A load error shown instead of the tree (true shows a neutral message).
Shows a Try again button with error.
Shown when nodes is empty; null shows nothing.
The whole tree out of the tab order and inert, dimmed. Single nodes take disabled on the node (focusable, not selectable, not expandable).
Width cap in px; 0 for none (fills its container).
Height of the scrolling area in px before it scrolls; 0 for none.
The footer with the focused path, status messages and key hints. Default: on for the sample content, off otherwise.
Show the sample layers panel and file tree (only when no nodes are passed).
The root section.
